c: Between 1920 and 1922, cartoonists Walt Disney, Ub Iwerks and Fred Harman worked at the Slide Company (soon renamed to Kansas City Film Ad Company), which produced cutout animation commercials.
def: Walter Elias Disney was an American animator, film producer, voice actor, and entrepreneur.

c: Castle in the Sky was the first feature for Studio Ghibli, founded in 1985 by Miyazaki with Isao Takahata and others.
def: Isao Takahata was a Japanese director, screenwriter and producer.
